jd.title: Product Designer
jd.external_text:
Vitalis Health is on a mission to reimagine how people engage with their wellbeing. We are a venture-backed startup building the next generation of digital health experiences, and design sits at the heart of everything we do. This is a chance to join us at an inflection point and leave your fingerprints on the whole product.

What you'll do
- Own the end-to-end design process across our product surfaces.
- Partner cross-functionally to translate business needs into delightful user experiences.
- Champion the voice of the user throughout the product lifecycle.
- Contribute to and evolve our design language as it matures.
- Wear many hats. This is a startup and no two weeks look quite the same.

Requirements
- Proven experience designing beautiful, intuitive digital products.
- A strong portfolio that demonstrates end-to-end thinking, not just final screens.
- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
- Passionate about healthcare and about improving outcomes for real people.
- A collaborative mindset and a bias for action.

Nice to have
- Health-tech, wellness or regulated consumer product experience.
- Familiarity with design systems at scale.
- Motion design or high-fidelity prototyping.

What we offer
- Remote-first culture with flexible hours.
- Meaningful equity and a seat at the table.
- The chance to work directly with the founders and shape the product from the ground up.
